bio.text: Brock Colvin, a Republican, has represented District 26 in the Alabama House of Representatives since taking office on November 9, 2022, and is on the November 3, 2026 general election ballot for re-election.
Colvin was born and lives in Albertville, graduated from Albertville High School in 2014, and has worked as a financial planner with Ameriprise Financial.
